items.title: Dave Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: the Chris Barber band, the Dutch Swing College Band, Kenny Ball, lots of very good groups.

ctx.x: Didn’t the European musicians try to emulate those sounds that they were hearing on those records and come up doing some pretty strange things to try to sound like those 78s?

Well as far as traditional jazz there’s actually another stylistic branch of the music that’s called European trad or sometimes British trad although it wasn’t confined to Britain. But they, just as the San Francisco people, Turk Murphy and Lu Watters and people like that did essentially their own twist on the classic New Orleans sound, the Europeans did their own twist on the New Orleans revival sound, that loose forties kind of thing. But they made it less loose, it was more polished, a little more structured,…
Does the word “trad” by itself have connotations that the word “traditional” does not?
